reconstruction.R1: offline FP16 channel mean/scale plus FP16 local RMS multiplier
reconstruction.R2: FP16 local channel mean/scale, 128-token causal blocks
reconstruction.R3: FP16 local channel mean/scale; K shares128 tokens, V shares32 tokens

local_statistics: only arrived tokens; parameter updates require reencoding affected stored codewords and version/cost accounting
zero_bit: no payload; reconstruct metadata mean; retain token in softmax

reading_units.K: one channel in a <=128-token block per KV head
reading_units.V: one token across all128 channels per KV head

controllers.C0: current query / reconstructed-K attention and common ideal distortion shape
controllers.C1: current query / reconstructed attention with fitted physical-scale MSE curves
controllers.C2: C1 with separately enabled causal local correction factor
controllers.C3: current query / reconstructed attention with calibration-only projected attention-output Jacobian corrected curves

costs.main_budget: separate K/V payload ceilings of3 bits per accessed element
costs.hardware_phase: true bit-plane DRAM/latency/throughput validation later; no speedup claim from reference implementation

common_execution.prefill: native FP16, encode arrived KV for subsequent decode

failure_policy: stop on numerical/causal/budget/identity violations; keep all valid negative quality results; no silent truncation or sample replacement
